analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1.08) vs SMA5/20/50 ($1.07/$1.09/$1.10) — Above short-term SMA5, below mid-term SMA20/50, indicating a sideways range.
· Significantly below SMA100/200 ($1.21/$1.35) — Long-term downtrend persists.
· 52-week position (2.8%) — Slightly recovering from historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.2→45.7) — Attempting to exit oversold territory, now consolidating in neutral zone without clear direction.
· MACD histogram trajectory (prev→curr) — Improving in negative territory (-0.0025→-0.0012), but trend reversal signals remain weak.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle band $1.09) — Trading around the middle band, searching for direction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.06) — Near 5-day low and Pivot S1 ($1.03), requires confirmation of support.
· Swing resistance ($1.13) — Adjacent to SMA50 ($1.10) and Pivot R1 ($1.14), potential for upside breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern — 5-day low ($1.05) equals 20-day low ($1.05), and 5-day high ($1.09) is lower than 20-day high ($1.16), confirming a sideways pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.05x 5-day average) — Normal volume levels, indicating moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis — Consolidation within accumulation phase, observing 5-day low support ($1.06) and potential break of 5-day high ($1.09).
